description: This file contains shell script code for testing various aspects of Git submodule handling, including URL validation, submodule addition, cloning, and fsck checks for URL scheme correctness and security issues.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executes the provided shell commands.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the provided command fails.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Simulates a time tick or advances time in tests.
